descriptionEn: House for sale with an area of 400m², located on Rruga Sali Butka, in Taslixhe, Prishtina. The house is positioned on a plot of 2 ares and consists of four residential floors, as well as a basement with direct access to the yard.
On the ground floor there are a reception room, a separate kitchen, one bathroom and a balcony overlooking the yard.
The first floor consists of a family living room and one bedroom with a balcony, also overlooking the yard.
On the second floor there are three bedrooms, one bathroom and two balconies, accessed from the rooms.
The third floor, arranged in the roof space, contains a separate room with an open view towards the city of Prishtina.

In total, the house has two living rooms, a separate kitchen, five bedrooms, two bathrooms, five balconies and a basement. The property needs partial renovation, offering the opportunity to adapt the spaces to the needs and style of the new owner.
The house has an ownership certificate and regular documentation.

The price of the property is €270,000, or €675/m².
Compensation with a car or an apartment in Prishtina is also accepted, by agreement.
